WITH latest_stages AS (
            SELECT 
              ss.symbol, 
              ss.stage, 
              ss.stage_score, 
              ss.trading_signal, 
              ss.price
            FROM 
              scores.stage_snapshots ss
            WHERE 
              ss.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
        )
        SELECT 
          ph.symbol, 
          ph.qty, 
          ph.avg_cost, 
          ss.stage, 
          ss.stage_score, 
          ss.trading_signal, 
          ss.price
        FROM 
          portfolio.holdings ph
        JOIN 
          latest_stages ss ON ph.symbol = ss.symbol;
